root_tolerance_s: Unchanged max(0.005 s, 0.005 * independent convolution root)
range_selection: For known equipment and inertia, prepare the direct-convolution root for each possible single outage before event inference; choose the smallest permitted fit horizon with that root <= 0.95*horizon. No benchmark residual selects the range. The FNP output is obtained from the degree-6 polynomial, never replaced with the direct root.
original_method_boundary: Uses Liu2020 Eq.(8)-(17) and recommended degree/range bounds; this equipment-conditioned range selection is a disclosed adaptation choice, not an alleged author implementation.
failure: No reference root inside 19 s, unsupported unit identity, or no eligible polynomial root produces unavailable/no-valid-root; never extend range after test errors.
